versions.changelog:
Initial release of snapshot-config-reader.

- Reads configuration data embedded within PNG snapshot images.
- Extracts config blocks from three channels: trailer (post-IEND), EXIF maker-notes, and pixel LSBs.
- Supports inspecting embedded config from images stored under snapshots/.
- CLI tool provided for reading and printing extracted sections.
- Requires only Python 3.10+ (standard library); no external dependencies.
